skill.name: listicle-blog-writer
skill.description: Write "best X tools/products" listicle blog articles optimized for SEO and GEO/AEO (AI engine citation by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). Use when the user asks for a listicle, comparison article, "best tools" post, roundup article, "top 10 X" blog, or any content meant to rank on Google and earn AI citations. Also trigger when the user mentions optimizing content for LLM citation, answer engines, or wants their own product featured in a comparison article.
skill.userDescription: Craft SEO and GEO/AEO optimized listicle blog articles and roundup posts to rank on search engines and earn AI engine citations.
exampleQuestions: Write a top 10 listicle blog post about the best AI coding assistant tools for developers in 2026.
Create a comparison roundup article of the top project management software for remote startup teams.
Draft an SEO and AI-citation optimized article reviewing the best email marketing automation software.
